title: アルゼンチン共和国杯の後に・とどけ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even with senior-year runners among her opponents, Tosen Jordan gets great results in this G2 race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brimming with enthusiasm after hearing her friends' cheers, she declares her intention to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her toenails are improving. They shouldn't get any worse, and we can expect a complete recovery if we keep up our efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the Arima Kinen is a fierce G1 race. I have some concerns, but Jordan calmly states that all we can do is try our best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is her courage a mark of ignorance, or just pure recklessness? Only time will tell—the Arima Kinen is just a month away.
